items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And my name is Dick Allen...

ctx.x: And my name is Dick Allen, and we're doing an interview today in the Seminar Room 2, the Howard Tilton Library, Tulane University. What is today's date? Is it September the 20... I don't know. 27, 1965 I think. Anyway it's Monday. So, I wanted to ask you a few things about jazz in Sweden and New Orleans, if there's any relationship between the two. When were you born by the way?
